Chasen Graphics v0.1.5 requires Zig 0.17.1.

- The optional terminal image adapter now uses Chasen v0.1.6. Applications using the adapter can update both packages together. [Chasen v0.1.6](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/releases/tag/v0.1.6)
- The core graphics module remains std-only.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-graphics/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.5)
